abstract: Shooting ranges in Thailand needed a simple tool for measuring shooting speed, but existing shot timer applications were complicated, not user friendly, and often paid. The project built Pro Timer, an Android application that records shot time and split time by detecting the sound of each shot. It was developed in Android Studio with Kotlin and uses Firebase for authentication, profile data, profile pictures, and shooting history. Users can adjust sound sensitivity in decibels and save up to 40 rounds per session with dated history. Testing on a real device led to fixes such as a single button design, UI adjustment to the target device, and a decibel value option converted from amplitude.

canonical_title: Video Analytics from IP Cameras for Smart Homes
abstract: Medical Alert systems are in high demand in the healthcare industry. Furthermore, with a generally ageing population, medical alert systems that assist family members and caretakers in nursing homes are extremely sought after. Fall detection systems have been a hot topic of research over the past two decades as fall accidents are one of the most fatal yet frequent occurrences an elderly person may experience. The goal of our project is to create a robust and accurate fall detection system as well as a portable demonstration kit for the management of BAKSTERS to demonstrate our system to the stakeholders and potential customers. By utilising PoseNet's pose estimation model to extract skeletal data from image frames, our system analyses a series of skeletal information through Deep Learning to identify the event of a fall. Through this methodology, our model in conjunction with the demo kit was able to perform with over 94% accuracy when detecting and notifying the user of fall events. Having tested in multiple different environments, we have produced a highly reliable fall detection system that is robust and accurate when utilising the portable demonstration kit.

Small companies don't want enormous amounts of data but just enough to help with their research. That is the problem we're going to solve. canonical_title: AU TOKEN: Smart Tokens for Assumption University Using Blockchain
abstract:
Students have an explicit goal in mind when studying. Even so, they are probably lost toward the destination. Besides, they sometimes lose motivation for some subjects or do not fully enjoy the student life due to the excessive focus on the goal. From the institution's perspective, recruiting the staff for some activities is also challenging if students are not wholeheartedly joyful. With all the spotted problems, the virtual currencies that can incentivize students to put more effort and act as a sub-goal to regain the motivation are tremendously necessary.

AU Token, known as ATK, is an education application built on Hyperledger Fabric to establish the infrastructure of permissioned blockchain. It aims to provide the virtual currencies system and serve as a foundation for further applications. ATK has two tokens: Academic token, known as ACA, and lifestyle token, known as LIF. These two can be used to purchase the privilege capable of improving student life experience using the ATK for Student in iOS platform to interact with the blockchain. To fulfill the transparency and trustworthy characteristics, ATK provides ATK Explorer to display transactions happening in the system. Furthermore, for ease of governing, ATK provides ATK Admin to the concerned party of the university to manage the privileges and token distribution.

abstract: Fake news has caused many problems around the world that lead to many people have become a victim of this seemingly uncontrollable problem. What's make fake news so dangerous is that anyone can post it especially in this covid-19 situation where the trend of the increasing of number of people who use internet. Many people tried to prevent these fake news problems and contain it to be as minimal as possible including the Government. Thailand Government's ministry of digital economy and society has created a website called antifakenewscenter.com which contain all fake news and real news that has been confirmed by the Government ministry, but it has some minor problems such as unable to handle fuzzy matching and hard to use. After seeing these problems, I decided to create a solution for people who find it hard to use the service provided by the ministry. My service is an google chrome extension that help checking Thai fake news using the data from antifakenewscenter.com We use google chrome extension because of two reasons. First due to, people can easily install the extension into their chrome client and use our service. And secondly, majority of Thailand population are using google chrome as their main browser.

abstract: Real-time estimations of the presence of people in a space can help administrators better manage a space, save unnecessary costs, and provide better services. In this paper, we propose a technique to estimate the number of mobile devices in a certain place at a certain time through the Wi-Fi probe request issued by the device with a wireless network function, so as to judge whether there is a person in the place. Compared with the method using camera detection, the cost of this method is lower, and the privacy of people in the venue can be better protected. We also provide a front-end page that makes it easier for administrators to view real-time or period data reports. It also supports real-time notification of administrators when certain conditions are triggered, such as when the number of people exceeds so that corresponding measures can be carried out.

abstract: The project designed and built a low-cost occupancy monitoring system using an 8x8 pixel AMG8833 IR thermal sensor, which preserves privacy because it senses people by body heat rather than cameras. Temperature data from the sensor was read with an AMG8833 Python library and saved as JSON, then used to train a machine learning model with scikit-learn. The system runs on a microcontroller with the sensor, visualizes the room as a heatmap, and serves a Flask web interface that records data to Firebase Realtime Database. It displays low, medium, and high occupancy levels and shows an alert when occupancy reaches the maximum. Testing at the Baksters office reported 98 to 100 percent accuracy for indoor temperatures between 21 and 31 degrees Celsius when people passing at average walking speed measured above 35 degrees. The main limitation is that it is still hard to distinguish a human from a moving heat source.
